description: Implementation of the CU-CP (Central Unit Control Plane) component for a 5G network, including handling of UE context, handovers, paging, measurement reports, and connection management.

classes.name: cu_cp_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing the CU-CP control plane logic, handling UE management, handovers, paging, and connection routines.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the CU-CP component, establishing connections and setting up timers.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the CU-CP component, shutting down timers and connections.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_release_request
methods.description: Handles requests to release bearer contexts for a UE.

methods.name: handle_handover_request
methods.description: Processes handover requests for a UE, selecting target cells and managing context transfer.

methods.name: handle_location_reporting_control_message
methods.description: Handles NGAP location reporting control messages, configuring location reporting and triggering immediate reports.

methods.name: send_ran_paging
methods.description: Constructs and sends RAN paging messages to a UE, starting paging timers.
